title: Blind Scoring Sheet: Reduction-Ratio Lettering Trial (1921 Treatise)
purpose: A concrete, fillable data-collection instrument for the reduction-ratio test proposed in artifact 1156693e. Provides a TSV scoring sheet for 10 paired comparisons plus a summary tally, so an evaluator can run the blind trial described in Scout's checklist.md and produce a result that is inspectable and shareable. No drawing is included; this is the measurement tool, not the experiment setup.
